body.prompt: At a Korean family holiday dinner table full of dishes, an older Korean relative in his sixties points his chopsticks and smirks while speaking loudly; a Korean woman in her early fifties, short permed dark hair with a few grey strands, round kind face, wearing a soft burgundy knit cardigan sits across from him, everyone else at the table falls silent and looks at her.
